data.gender_notes: Daajiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word ‘daaj’ which means ‘to persist, to continue’. Daajiyah is a name for a woman who embodies determination, endurance, and tenacity. In Islamic tradition, Daajiyah is a symbol of unwavering faith and resilience. The name Daajiyah carries the meaning “Persistent, tenacious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Daajiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody persistent, tenacious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
